<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>D'ôce Geladinho Gourmet 😋</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka+One&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --pink: #FF3E8A;
    --pink-light: #FF6BA8;
    --yellow: #FFD93D;
    --coral: #FF6B6B;
    --mint: #4ECDC4;
    --purple: #A855F7;
    --blue: #60B4FF;
    --white: #FFFBF5;
    --dark: #1A1A2E;
    --text: #3D2C2C;
    --wa: #25D366;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--text);
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, .brand {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
  }

  /* ===== FLOATING CTA ===== */
  .float-cta {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    z-index: 999;
    background: var(--wa);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 14px 22px;
    font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(37,211,102,0.45);
    animation: pulse-wa 2s infinite;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  @keyframes pulse-wa {
    0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(37,211,102,0.45); transform: scale(1); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(37,211,102,0.65); transform: scale(1.04); }
  }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF3E8A 0%, #FF6B6B 40%, #FFD93D 100%);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px 20px 60px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .hero::before {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-badge {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 6px 18px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  .brand {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 7.5vw, 3.8rem);
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 3px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    line-height: 1.15;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    max-width: 480px;
  }

  .brand span { color: var(--yellow); }

  .hero-sub {
    font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 1.6rem);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
    font-weight: 800;
    max-width: 480px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }

  /* Geladinho SVG illustration */
  .hero-img {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 auto 30px;
    width: min(300px, 70vw);
  }

  .geladinhos-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 10px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.22));
  }

  @keyframes spin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }

  @keyframes float {
    0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
  }

  /* SVG geladinhos animados */
  .geladinhos-row svg {
    animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .geladinhos-row svg:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .geladinhos-row svg:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; animation-duration: 2.6s; }
  .geladinhos-row svg:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.9s; }
  .geladinhos-row svg:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.2s; }

  .cta-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: var(--wa);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    padding: 18px 36px;
    border-radius: 60px;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .cta-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
  .cta-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

  .hero-urgency {
    margin-top: 16px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .hero-urgency span {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
  }

  /* ===== WAVE ===== */
  .wave-divider {
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    line-height: 0;
    background: var(--white);
  }
  .wave-divider svg { display: block; width: 100%; }

  /* ===== SABORES ===== */
  .section {
    padding: 60px 20px;
  }

  .section-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .section-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    background: var(--yellow);
    color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    padding: 5px 16px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .section-title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3rem);
    color: var(--dark);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .section-title span { color: var(--pink); }

  .section-desc {
    color: #666;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 10px;
    max-width: 460px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  /* Cards de sabores */
  .sabores-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    max-width: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .card-sabor {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 20px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    position: relative;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .card-sabor:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    border-color: var(--pink);
  }

  .card-sabor.mais-vendido { border-color: var(--yellow); }

  .badge-top {
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    right: 12px;
    background: var(--yellow);
    color: var(--dark);
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .card-emoji {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .card-name {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }

  .card-desc {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: #888;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    min-height: 36px;
  }

  .card-price {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    color: var(--pink);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .btn-sabor {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--coral));
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }
  .btn-sabor:hover { opacity: 0.88; }

  /* ===== DIFERENCIAIS ===== */
  .diferenciais {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A1A2E 0%, #16213E 100%);
    padding: 70px 20px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .diferenciais .section-title { color: #fff; }
  .diferenciais .section-tag { background: var(--pink); color: #fff; }

  .diferenciais-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .dif-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px 16px;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .dif-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

  .dif-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .dif-title {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--yellow);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .dif-text {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* ===== DEPOIMENTOS ===== */
  .depoimentos {
    background: #FFF5F8;
    padding: 70px 20px;
  }

  .dep-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .dep-card {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    border-left: 4px solid var(--pink);
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .dep-stars {
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  .dep-text {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .dep-author {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .dep-avatar {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .dep-info strong {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--dark);
  }

  .dep-info span {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #aaa;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* ===== FINAL CTA ===== */
  .final-cta {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink) 0%, var(--coral) 50%, var(--yellow) 100%);
    padding: 80px 20px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .final-cta::before, .final-cta::after { display: none; }

  .final-cta h2 {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 7vw, 3.5rem);
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 2px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .final-cta p {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    max-width: 380px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  .cta-big {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--wa);
    font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    border-radius: 70px;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .cta-big:hover { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }

  .urgency-row {
    margin-top: 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .urgency-item {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    border-radius: 30px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
  footer {
    background: var(--dark);
    padding: 40px 20px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .footer-brand {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: var(--yellow);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .footer-tagline {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .footer-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .footer-links a {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--yellow); }

  .footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }

  /* ===== STRIPE decorativo ===== */
  .stripe {
    height: 10px;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pink) 0, var(--pink) 20px, var(--yellow) 20px, var(--yellow) 40px, var(--mint) 40px, var(--mint) 60px, var(--blue) 60px, var(--blue) 80px);
  }

  /* ===== CONTAGEM ===== */
  .social-proof-bar {
    background: var(--yellow);
    padding: 12px 20px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--dark);
  }

  /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
  @media (min-width: 600px) {
    .sabores-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .dep-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

    .diferenciais-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  }

  /* Animações de entrada */
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .fade-up {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease forwards;
  }
  .fade-up:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

  .hero-content > * {
    animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease forwards;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.65s; }
  .hero-content > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.8s; }
</style>
</head>

<div class="social-proof-bar">

    <p class="hero-urgency"><span>⚡ Atendimento rápido · Resposta em minutos</span></p>

</section>

<!-- Wave -->
<div class="wave-divider">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 80" preserveAspectRatio="none" height="60">
    <path d="M0,40 C300,90 900,-10 1200,40 L1200,80 L0,80 Z" fill="#FFFBF5"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<!-- ===== SABORES ===== -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-header">
    <span class="section-tag">🍧 Cardápio</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Escolha o seu <span>favorito</span></h2>
    <p class="section-desc">Cada sabor é uma explosão de cremosidade feita com muito carinho 🥰</p>

  <style>
  .carrossel-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: min(280px, 75vw);
    margin: 0 auto 28px;
  }
  .carrossel {
    position: relative;
    height: 300px;
  }
  .slide {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    border: 4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  }
  .slide.active { display: block; }
  .slide img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  .slide-label {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  }
  .carr-btn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50%;
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    z-index: 10;
    line-height: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    color: #FF3E8A;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .carr-btn.prev { left: -18px; }
  .carr-btn.next { right: -18px; }
  .carr-dots {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
  .dot {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    margin: 0 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s;
  }
  .dot.active { background: #fff; }
  </style>

  <script>
  var curr = 0;
  var slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  var dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
  function goTo(n) {
    slides[curr].classList.remove('active');
    dots[curr].classList.remove('active');
    curr = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
    slides[curr].classList.add('active');
    dots[curr].classList.add('active');
  }
  function moveSlide(dir) { goTo(curr + dir); }
  setInterval(function(){ moveSlide(1); }, 2800);
  </script>

<script>
  // Intersection Observer para animações de scroll
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
        entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.card-sabor, .dif-card, .dep-card').forEach(el => {
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
</script>
